title: beckera dioica

It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Kawakawa have been shown to have a range of biological activities, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial actions, making it a promising candidate for further research into its potential therapeutic applications.
